title: Compact-Bench: Measuring What Context Compaction Costs Long-Horizon Coding Agents
title_zh: Compact-Bench：衡量上下文压缩对长时程编码智能体的代价

paragraphs.en: Context compaction lets long-horizon coding agents continue beyond their context windows, but can erase the state needed to finish a task. Prior evaluations measure efficiency, retained information, or end-to-end success, leaving the effect of a specific history replacement difficult to isolate. Compact-Bench pairs full-history and summary-only continuations from a shared repository state, and evaluates recurring details and successive production compactions. It covers 35 35 SWE-bench repairs, 146 146 agentic sessions, and 106 106 production chains. Across 14 14 summarizer backbones, stable damage ranges from 5 − 64 % 5-64\% of 22 22 full-history successes: Claude Opus 4.8 4.8 preserves the most repairs, while DeepSeek-Flash damages the most. With Kimi-K3 as summarizer, the Kimi Code prompt preserves the most task continuations ( 19 / 22 19/22 ), whereas Claude Code retains the most recurring details ( 15.0 % 15.0\% ). LLM summaries retain at most 16.0 % 16.0\% of recurring details, compared with 79.1 % 79.1\% for mechanical extraction; production summaries retain 15.7 % 15.7\% at the first boundary. Failures recur across methods: one repair is damaged by 13 / 14 13/14 backbones, and another by all 5 5 prompts. These results show that reliable compaction requires preserving the progress needed to complete a task, and that retaining relevant information alone does not ensure successful continuation. Code and data are available online.

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon coding agents accumulate instructions, tool observations, test results, and partial decisions. Compaction allows them to work beyond the context window, but the resulting summary must carry enough state to resume unfinished work. Long-context benchmarks test retrieval, reasoning, and generation from extended inputs ( Bai et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Shaham et al., 2023 ; An et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Kuratov et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ) , and information access can depend on input position ( Liu et al., 2024a ) . Agent histories add a further requirement: preserving which actions have been taken, which hypotheses have been rejected, and what remains to be done.
paragraphs.zh: 长时程编码智能体会不断积累指令、工具观测结果、测试结果以及部分已做出的决策。 压缩使它们能够超出上下文窗口工作，但压缩产生的摘要必须携带足够的状态信息，以便恢复未完成的工作。 长上下文基准测试检验从扩展输入中进行检索、推理和生成的能力（ Bai et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Shaham et al., 2023 ; An et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Kuratov et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ），且信息获取可能取决于输入位置（ Liu et al., 2024a ）。 智能体历史还增加了一项额外要求：保留哪些操作已经执行、哪些假设已被排除、以及还有哪些工作尚待完成。

paragraphs.en: End-to-end benchmarks evaluate repository repair, code generation, and interactive tool use ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Jain et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024c ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) . A final score, however, does not isolate the effect of replacing a history midway through a task. Recent compaction evaluations examine constraint loss, archived-fact retrieval, future-trajectory support, and execution instability; methods also learn or schedule summarization and remove observations ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Subramani, 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Min et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Cim et al., 2026 ; Lindenbauer et al., 2025 ) . Compact-Bench targets the history replacement itself: it compares full-history and summary-only continuation at a shared boundary, then examines detail retention in real agent sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端基准测试评估仓库修复、代码生成和交互式工具使用（Jimenez et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025；Xia et al., 2025；Jain et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2024c；Yao et al., 2025；Zhou et al., 2024；Xie et al., 2024）。 然而，最终得分无法分离在任务中途替换历史所产生的效果。 近期的压缩评估考察了约束损失、归档事实检索、未来轨迹支持以及执行不稳定性；相关方法还会学习或调度摘要生成并移除观测内容（Wang et al., 2026；Subramani, 2026；Chen et al., 2026；Min et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026a；Wu et al., 2025b；Sun et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026b；Cim et al., 2026；Lindenbauer et al., 2025）。 Compact-Bench 则直接针对历史替换本身：它在共享边界处比较完整历史与仅摘要的续写表现，进而考察真实智能体会话中的细节保留情况。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark asks: For the same task and pre-compaction state, how does continuation change when an agent receives only a summary instead of its full history? Task Preservation compares full-history and summary-only continuations from the same repository snapshot, using the same agent, step budget, and executable tests. Recurring-Detail Retention measures preservation of structured details that recur in later requests across 146 146 sessions ( 143 143 real and 3 3 simulator-synthesized). Production-Chain Retention follows these details across successive compactions in 106 106 real sessions. Together, the three evaluations connect controlled task outcomes with information retention in deployed workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试提出的问题是：对于相同的任务和压缩前的状态，当智能体仅收到摘要而非完整历史时，继续执行会发生什么变化？ 任务保持（Task Preservation）在同一仓库快照下比较完整历史与仅摘要两种继续执行，使用相同的智能体、步骤预算和可执行的测试。 重复细节保持（Recurring-Detail Retention）衡量在 146 个会话（143 个真实会话和 3 个模拟器合成会话）中，后续请求中重复出现的结构化细节的保留情况。 生产链保持（Production-Chain Retention）在 106 个真实会话中跟踪这些细节在连续多次压缩中的保留情况。 这三项评估共同将受控的任务结果与部署工作流中的信息保留联系起来。

Our recurring-detail and production-chain tracks assess structured information that reappears after compaction in coding-agent workflows.

paragraphs.en: Prompt compression reduces input length through token selection (Selective Context, LLMLingua), question-aware selection (LongLLMLingua), distilled selection (LLMLingua-2), soft representations (Gist tokens, ICAE), and offline compression with adaptation (LLoCO) ( Li et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2024 ; Mu et al., 2023 ; Ge et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2024 ) . RECOMP compresses retrieved passages; a survey organizes the broader method families ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Summary evaluation measures factual consistency and answerability, including Kryscinski et al., FEQA, and QuestEval; G-Eval uses LLM judgments for broader generation quality ( Kryscinski et al., 2020 ; Durmus et al., 2020 ; Scialom et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) . Compact-Bench extends the evaluation target to resuming agent work, combining executable outcomes with deterministic matching of recurring details.

paragraphs.en: Task Preservation tests whether continuation from S S completes repairs that also succeed from H H . For each repair, Phase A caches a history after at most 10 10 steps and shares it across tested methods and seeds. PRE and POST then continue from the same snapshot D D , using the same agent, tools, environment, and eight-step limit; the repository’s FAIL_TO_PASS tests judge both outcomes. An instance-method pair is preserved when both continuations pass, damaged when PRE passes and POST fails, a rescue when PRE fails and POST passes, and unsolved when both fail. The paired labels preserve the direction of each change: damage identifies a lost full-history success, while rescue identifies a success reached from the summary after full-history failure. Reporting these separately prevents improvements on some repairs from cancelling losses on others in an aggregate success rate. First-round damage and rescue cases receive two additional seeds. A backbone case counts as stable damage when POST fails in at least two of its three runs; the prompt comparison uses one run per case. Appendix B reports the repeatability results.

paragraphs.en: Recurring-Detail Retention measures literal preservation of structured values that occur both before an artificial boundary in a never-compacted session and in the next 3 3 to 8 8 request payloads. Future payloads include retransmitted history, so recurrence denotes continued presence in the interaction. Production-Chain Retention scores details found in the next at most 5 5 request payloads after each real compaction boundary, without requiring a match in the pre-boundary history. It also records whether a summary describes a completed file write as pending work. The two retention tracks use different boundaries for complementary purposes. Artificial boundaries allow the same recorded history to be summarized by multiple methods and scored against a common reference set. Production boundaries expose the summaries emitted during ongoing work, including successive replacements within one session. Task Preservation adds the execution outcome, so the benchmark reports both what remains in a summary and what the continuation accomplishes from it.
paragraphs.zh: Recurring-Detail Retention（重复细节保留度）衡量的是结构化值的字面保留情况，这些值既出现在未压缩会话中人工边界之前，也出现在之后 3 到 8 个请求载荷中。 未来的载荷包含重传的历史内容，因此重复出现表示其在交互中的持续存在。 Production-Chain Retention（生产链保留度）对每次真实压缩边界之后最多 5 个请求载荷中出现的细节进行评分，且不要求与边界前历史内容匹配。 它还会记录某条摘要是否将已完成的文件写入描述为待办工作。 这两条保留度评估线使用不同的边界来达成互补的目的。 人工边界允许用多种方法对同一段记录的历史进行摘要，并针对一个共同的参考集进行评分。 生产边界则展现持续工作中产生的摘要，包括同一会话内的 successive 替换。 Task Preservation（任务保留度）在此基础上加入执行结果，因此该基准测试同时报告摘要中保留了什么，以及后续续写基于该摘要完成了什么。

paragraphs.en: The task set contains 35 localized SWE-bench repairs from 7 7 repositories: pytest ( 18 18 ), sympy ( 6 6 ), xarray ( 3 3 ), pylint ( 3 3 ), requests ( 2 2 ), sphinx ( 2 2 ), and flask ( 1 1 ). Selection favors fixes confined to one test file, few FAIL_TO_PASS tests, and a median gold patch below 1 1 KB. This concentrates evaluation on whether a continuation can turn the accumulated state into a specific repair. Each instance has a repository-specific environment recipe: Python 3.9 supports older repositories, while dependency constraints include numpy<2 for xarray, era-matched sphinxcontrib-* packages for sphinx, and py for pylint. Inclusion requires the base repository to fail the FAIL_TO_PASS tests and the gold patch to pass them. Appendix E provides instance-level tests and environment details.
paragraphs.zh: 任务集包含来自 7 7 个代码库的 35 个本地化的 SWE-bench 修复任务：pytest（18 18）、sympy（6 6）、xarray（3 3）、pylint（3 3）、requests（2 2）、sphinx（2 2）以及 flask（1 1）。 选择标准倾向于修复范围限于单个测试文件、FAIL_TO_PASS 测试数量少、且黄金补丁中位数小于 1 1 KB 的实例。 这将评估聚焦于：一个续写能否将累积的状态转化为一个具体的修复。 每个实例都有一个特定于代码库的环境配置：Python 3.9 支持较旧的代码库，而依赖约束包括 xarray 需要 numpy<2、sphinx 需要版本匹配的 sphinxcontrib-* 软件包、pylint 需要 py。 纳入的条件是：基础代码库必须未通过 FAIL_TO_PASS 测试，且黄金补丁必须使其通过。 附录 E 提供了实例级别的测试与环境细节。

paragraphs.en: This track uses 146 146 sessions from coding-agent harness trajectory: 73 73 Kimi Code, 50 50 Claude Code, 14 14 opencode, and 9 9 other clients, including 3 3 simulator-synthesized sessions. paragraphs.en: We check three properties before scoring: solvability (the gold patch passes in the supplied environment), discriminability (the base repository fails the FAIL_TO_PASS tests), and protocol validity (the agent and test judge use the same interpreter, and agent tests run against the live working tree).
paragraphs.zh: 在打分前我们检查三个性质：可解性（黄金补丁在所提供的环境中可通过测试）、区分性（基础仓库无法通过 FAIL_TO_PASS 测试）以及协议有效性（智能体与测试判官使用相同的解释器，且智能体的测试针对实时工作树运行）。

paragraphs.en: The agent and judge use the same per-instance interpreter, with PATH and PYTHONPATH pointing to the evaluation environment and live working tree. Phase A, PRE, and POST execute in the same directory, and the cached working-tree snapshot is restored before each continuation. This preserves the meaning of paths appearing in the history or summary and places both outcomes under the same conditions. Appendix D reports validation experiments for these controls.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体与评判者使用相同的按实例解释器，其 PATH 和 PYTHONPATH 指向评估环境与实时工作树。 Phase A、PRE 与 POST 在同一目录中执行，并且在每次继续之前都会恢复缓存的工作树快照。 这保留了历史记录或摘要中出现的路径的含义，并使两种结果处于相同的条件下。 附录 D 报告了针对这些控制的验证实验。

Auxiliary human validation of decision and progress labels is documented separately in Appendix D ; these labels do not enter the reported retention scores.

paragraphs.en: The prompt grid separates shared failures from prompt-specific losses (Appendix F ). Sphinx-9230 fails under all five prompts, and pytest-7571 fails under four. In contrast, xarray-3677, pylint-6903, and pytest-7521 fail under opencode alone; pytest-7490 fails under Claude Code alone. Kimi Code and Claude Code also have different failure profiles: Kimi Code preserves the three pytest repairs damaged by Claude Code, while Claude Code preserves requests-5414 and sympy-13551, which Kimi Code damages. Sphinx-9230 is their shared failure. These profiles explain how the two leading prompts differ beyond their one-repair aggregate gap. The controlled prompt comparison also holds the summarizer fixed, demonstrating that the compaction instruction alone is a consequential configuration choice in this setup. Its case-level outcomes complement the backbone experiment, which holds the instruction fixed. Together, the two comparisons separate model choice from prompt choice while retaining the same continuation and executable criterion.

paragraphs.en: The joint results distinguish detail retention from task preservation. DeepSeek-Flash has the highest retention score under Claude Code but damages 14 14 of 22 22 repairs, compared with 4 4 for Kimi-K3. With Kimi-K3 fixed, Claude Code retains 15.0 % 15.0\% of recurring details versus 8.2 % 8.2\% for Kimi Code, while Kimi Code preserves one more repair. These are configuration-level comparisons across separate datasets. They show why evaluating both properties is useful: a configuration that preserves more recurring strings can still supply a less effective state for task continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 联合结果区分了细节保留与任务保持。 DeepSeek-Flash 在 Claude Code 下具有最高的保留得分，但损坏了 22 22 个修复中的 14 14 个，相比之下 Kimi-K3 为 4 4 个。 在 Kimi-K3 修复的情况下，Claude Code 保留了 15.0 % 15.0% 的重复出现细节，而 Kimi Code 为 8.2 % 8.2%，同时 Kimi Code 多保留了 1 个修复。 这些是跨独立数据集的配置级比较。 它们说明了为什么同时评估这两个属性是有用的：一个保留更多重复出现字符串的配置，仍然可能为任务延续提供效果较差的状态。

paragraphs.en: This diagnosis illustrates the role of paired continuation in the benchmark. Retention scores locate missing details; paired traces reveal how a preserved or altered working state unfolds into subsequent actions. On the inspected repairs, the decisive outcome is executable task completion, and paths or code tokens provide evidence for interpreting that outcome. Combining these views makes it possible to distinguish a missing identifier from a continuation that still has the identifier but does not complete the repair.
paragraphs.zh: 这一诊断说明了成对续写在基准测试中的作用。 保留分数用于定位缺失的细节；成对的轨迹则揭示一个被保留或被改变的工作状态如何展开为后续动作。 在所检查的修复中，决定性的结果是可执行的任务完成，而路径或代码词元为解释该结果提供证据。 结合这些视角可以区分「缺失某个标识符」与「仍拥有该标识符但未能完成修复的续写」这两种情况。

sents.en: This diagnosis illustrates the role of paired continuation in the benchmark.
sents.zh: 这一诊断说明了成对续写在基准测试中的作用。

sents.en: Retention scores locate missing details; paired traces reveal how a preserved or altered working state unfolds into subsequent actions.
sents.zh: 保留分数用于定位缺失的细节；成对的轨迹则揭示一个被保留或被改变的工作状态如何展开为后续动作。

sents.en: On the inspected repairs, the decisive outcome is executable task completion, and paths or code tokens provide evidence for interpreting that outcome.
sents.zh: 在所检查的修复中，决定性的结果是可执行的任务完成，而路径或代码词元为解释该结果提供证据。

sents.en: Combining these views makes it possible to distinguish a missing identifier from a continuation that still has the identifier but does not complete the repair.
sents.zh: 结合这些视角可以区分「缺失某个标识符」与「仍拥有该标识符但未能完成修复的续写」这两种情况。

paragraphs.en: Compact-Bench measures what survives context compaction through paired task continuation, recurring-detail matching, and real production chains. Its shared-boundary comparison separates summarizers by their ability to preserve executable repair progress: Claude Opus 4.8 4.8 has the lowest stable damage, with a 5 − 64 % 5-64\% range across fourteen backbones. Prompt choice also matters, with Kimi Code preserving the most repairs and Claude Code retaining the most recurring details under Kimi-K3. The paired failures establish the benchmark’s central distinction: retaining paths and code strings can coexist with losing the progress needed to finish a task. Evaluating both information and subsequent action makes that loss visible.
paragraphs.zh: Compact-Bench 通过成对任务延续、重复细节匹配以及真实生产链条，衡量上下文压缩后仍能保留的内容。 其共享边界对比按保留可执行修复进展的能力区分各摘要器：Claude Opus 4.8 4.8 的稳定损伤最低，在十四个骨干模型上的范围为 5 − 64 % 5-64\%。 提示词的选择同样重要：在 Kimi-K3 下，Kimi Code 保留的修复最多，而 Claude Code 保留的重复细节最多。 成对失败确立了该基准的核心区分：保留路径和代码字符串可能与丢失完成任务所需的进展并存。 同时评估信息与后续行动，使这种丢失变得可见。

paragraphs.en: The Recurring-Detail Retention and Production-Chain Retention evaluations use real agentic sessions collected from online agent traffic on the authors’ institutional platform under its existing data-use agreements; sessions were analyzed in place and were not solicited from users for this study. The data was processed to extract structural items (paths, identifiers, error types) for labeling. The paper reports aggregate retention statistics; private session payloads and session-level label values are not distributed. Paths, URLs, and IP addresses can identify users or infrastructure; the distributed artifacts therefore exclude these private session-level values. Task Preservation reuses public SWE-bench instances under their original licenses. All reported experiments were run through metered API gateways under the authors’ institutional accounts. The benchmark is intended to help identify and reduce compaction-induced failures in deployed coding agents.

paragraphs.en: Table 11 compares three harness settings: the system interpreter (v1), the instance interpreter with separate execution directories (v2), and the instance interpreter with a shared directory and snapshot restoration (v3). The benchmark uses v3. Interpreter alignment makes older repositories importable to both agent and judge; for example, sympy-13480 changes from unsolved to preserved. Directory alignment preserves the meaning of paths copied into summaries. In the separate-directory pilot, copied Phase-A paths redirected POST commands outside the judged tree in 22 of 34 cases. Sharing and restoring the directory resolves this mismatch: xarray-6721 and pytest-7521 change from damage to preserved, while sphinx-9230 remains damaged. These comparisons validate the environment and state controls used in the paired evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Decision and progress labels were examined separately from the deterministic retention metric. From 1,747 raw candidates, many originating in system prompts and skill documents, a stratified sample of 60 items (20 decisions and 40 progress items) was independently reviewed by a human and Kimi-K3. They agreed on 59 items ( 98.3 % 98.3\% ). One disagreement concerned a literal duplicate and was adjudicated in favor of the LLM annotation. The resulting auxiliary gold set contains 31 items from eight sessions. This review validates the auxiliary labels; the headline retention scores use the structured-value extraction rules in Appendix L .
paragraphs.zh: 决策与进度标签的审核与确定性的留存指标是分开进行的。 从 1,747 个原始候选标签（其中许多来自系统提示词和技能文档）中，抽取了 60 个条目的分层样本（20 个决策条目和 40 个进度条目），由一名人类和 Kimi-K3 独立审核。 双方在 59 个条目上达成一致（98.3%98.3\%）。 唯一一处分歧涉及一个字面意义上的重复条目，最终裁定采纳大语言模型的标注。 最终得到的辅助黄金集包含来自 8 个会话的 31 个条目。 这次审核验证了辅助标签；核心留存分数则使用附录 L 中的结构化数值提取规则。

paragraphs.en: The accompanying compact-bench-reproducibility.zip supplies reference extraction and scoring code, transcript preprocessing, coding-agent inputs and tool schemas, environment recipes, and file schemas described in Appendix L . The Task Preservation first-round grids and selected additional runs (Appendices A , B , and F ) support recomputation of the reported task rates. The package excludes private session payloads, historical candidate order and sampling budget, and cached Task Preservation histories and working-tree snapshots. The released rules and configurations specify the operations for implementing those evaluations.

paragraphs.en: Phase A allows at most 10 steps; each continuation at most 8; command timeout is 120s and test timeout is 300s. Compression inputs are preprocessed before the overall cap: in Task Preservation and cross-backbone runs, each text block is truncated to 2,000 characters and each tool input or output to 200 characters; in Recurring-Detail Retention, the limits are 4,000 and 500 characters; the serialized transcript is then capped at its last 250,000 characters. The anchor_index reference extracts from the first 400,000 characters of serialized history and keeps at most 40 values per type after sorting. Compression outputs are capped at 6,144 tokens for Kimi-K3 main runs and 16,384 tokens for cross-backbone and Recurring-Detail Retention runs. Each phase-A trajectory is cached and shared across methods and seeds; the working-directory snapshot is restored between PRE and POST.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 A 最多允许 10 步；每次续写最多 8 步；命令超时为 120 秒，测试超时为 300 秒。 压缩输入在总体上限之前进行预处理：在任务保留和跨骨干运行中，每个文本块被截断为 2,000 个字符，每个工具输入或输出被截断为 200 个字符；在重复细节保留中，限制分别为 4,000 和 500 个字符；随后序列化的对话记录被限制在其最后 250,000 个字符以内。 anchor_index 引用从序列化历史的前 400,000 个字符中提取，并在排序后每种类型最多保留 40 个值。 压缩输出在 Kimi-K3 主运行中被限制为 6,144 个 token，在跨骨干和重复细节保留运行中被限制为 16,384 个 token。 每条阶段 A 轨迹都会被缓存并在不同方法和种子之间共享；工作目录快照在 PRE 和 POST 之间被恢复。

paragraphs.en: Within a session, the sessionizer sorts requests by timestamp and request identifier. Pairs crossing a new compaction marker or a token drop below half the preceding count are excluded from the completeness denominator. Other pairs must have matching nonempty first-200-character message prefixes. When token counts are available, the next cached-token count must be at least 80% of the preceding total; missing fields do not fail that check. Completeness is the passing fraction, or 1 with no eligible pairs, rounded to three decimals before filtering at 0.8.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个会话内，会话切分器按时间戳和请求标识符对请求排序。 跨越新压缩标记的配对，或令牌数降至前一计数一半以下的配对，会被排除在完整性分母之外。 其他配对必须具有匹配的非空前 200 字符消息前缀。 当令牌计数可用时，下一个缓存令牌计数必须至少为前一总数的 80%；缺失字段不会导致该检查失败。 完整性是通过的比例，若没有符合条件的配对则为 1，在以 0.8 过滤之前先四舍五入到三位小数。

paragraphs.en: Section 3.2 defines the eligibility filters and boundary index. For requested sample budget N N , the constructor takes the first ⌊ N / 3 ⌋ \lfloor N/3\rfloor candidates from Claude Code, ⌊ N / 2 ⌋ \lfloor N/2\rfloor from Kimi Code, and ⌊ N / 5 ⌋ \lfloor N/5\rfloor from each other client. Groups follow client-name order and the concatenation is capped at N N . Missing payloads and samples with fewer than three matching recurring details are then removed.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3.2 节定义了资格过滤条件和边界索引。 对于请求的样本预算 N N ，构造器从 Claude Code 中取前 ⌊ N / 3 ⌋ \lfloor N/3\rfloor 个候选，从 Kimi Code 中取 ⌊ N / 2 ⌋ \lfloor N/2\rfloor 个，从每个其他客户端各取 ⌊ N / 5 ⌋ \lfloor N/5\rfloor 个。 各组按客户端名称顺序排列，拼接结果的上限为 N N 。 随后移除缺失负载以及匹配的重复细节少于三条的样本。

sents.zh: 对于请求的样本预算 N N ，构造器从 Claude Code 中取前 ⌊ N / 3 ⌋ \lfloor N/3\rfloor 个候选，从 Kimi Code 中取 ⌊ N / 2 ⌋ \lfloor N/2\rfloor 个，从每个其他客户端各取 ⌊ N / 5 ⌋ \lfloor N/5\rfloor 个。

sents.en: Groups follow client-name order and the concatenation is capped at N N .
sents.zh: 各组按客户端名称顺序排列，拼接结果的上限为 N N 。

sents.en: Missing payloads and samples with fewer than three matching recurring details are then removed.
sents.zh: 随后移除缺失负载以及匹配的重复细节少于三条的样本。

paragraphs.en: Recurring-Detail Retention extracts structured values from the first 400,000 characters of Python JSON serialization with ensure_ascii=False . Future text concatenates the first 150,000 characters of each available message payload from at most eight requests, without history deduplication. Production-Chain Retention uses the same per-request cap over at most five requests and omits the history intersection.
paragraphs.zh: 「循环细节保留」从使用 ensure_ascii=False 的 Python JSON 序列化的前 400,000 个字符中提取结构化值。 后续文本会从最多八个请求中拼接每个可用消息载荷的前 150,000 个字符，且不对历史记录去重。 「生产链保留」对最多五个请求使用相同的单请求上限，并省略历史记录交集。

paragraphs.en: The module specifies path whitelists and exclusions, slash normalization, SHA and other identifier patterns, and URL truncation to 120 characters. Deduplication is within each kind; equal values in different kinds remain distinct labels. Hits use case-sensitive substring membership. Recurring-Detail Retention averages non-null per-session scores without weighting sessions by their number of labels. API/parse errors are excluded; returned empty summaries score zero. The mechanical reference keeps at most 40 sorted values per kind from the bounded history extraction.
paragraphs.zh: 该模块指定路径白名单与排除项、斜杠规范化、SHA 及其他标识符模式，以及 URL 截断至 120 个字符。 去重在每种类型内部进行；不同类型中的相同值仍作为不同的标签保留。 命中判定使用区分大小写的子串匹配。 「反复出现细节保留度」对每个会话的非空得分取平均值，不按各会话的标签数量加权。 API/解析错误被排除在外；返回空摘要的得分为零。 该机械参考从有界历史提取中为每种类型最多保留 40 个已排序的值。

paragraphs.en: Successful-write patterns scan the immediately preceding raw message payload. A detected file’s basename must occur within 150 characters on either side of a pending phrase in the summary; any match flags the boundary. Missing prior payloads and payloads with no detected writes are recorded as unflagged. The rate therefore measures contradictions captured by these patterns. All retained boundaries enter its denominator; boundaries with at least one evaluable detail enter retention. The last-to-first ratio divides the final retained boundary’s retention by the first non-null retention, excluding null final values and zero denominators. Every first boundary in the reported corpus is scorable. The module contains the literal multilingual patterns and summary-extraction rules.
paragraphs.zh: 成功写入模式会扫描紧邻其前的原始消息载荷。 检测到的文件的基本文件名必须出现在摘要中待定短语前后 150 个字符以内；任何匹配都会标记该边界。 缺失先前载荷以及未检测到写入操作的载荷会被记录为未标记。 因此，该比率衡量的是这些模式所捕捉到的矛盾。 所有保留的边界都计入其分母；至少含有一个可评估细节的边界计入保留。 末尾对首部比值用最后一个保留边界的保留值除以第一个非空保留值，排除最终值为空以及分母为零的情况。 所报告语料中的每个首个边界都是可评分的。 该模块包含字面上的多语言模式和摘要提取规则。

sents.en: Successful-write patterns scan the immediately preceding raw message payload.
sents.zh: 成功写入模式会扫描紧邻其前的原始消息载荷。

sents.en: A detected file’s basename must occur within 150 characters on either side of a pending phrase in the summary; any match flags the boundary.
sents.zh: 检测到的文件的基本文件名必须出现在摘要中待定短语前后 150 个字符以内；任何匹配都会标记该边界。

sents.zh: 缺失先前载荷以及未检测到写入操作的载荷会被记录为未标记。

sents.en: The rate therefore measures contradictions captured by these patterns.
sents.zh: 因此，该比率衡量的是这些模式所捕捉到的矛盾。

sents.en: All retained boundaries enter its denominator; boundaries with at least one evaluable detail enter retention.
sents.zh: 所有保留的边界都计入其分母；至少含有一个可评估细节的边界计入保留。

sents.en: The last-to-first ratio divides the final retained boundary’s retention by the first non-null retention, excluding null final values and zero denominators.
sents.zh: 末尾对首部比值用最后一个保留边界的保留值除以第一个非空保留值，排除最终值为空以及分母为零的情况。

sents.en: Every first boundary in the reported corpus is scorable.
sents.zh: 所报告语料中的每个首个边界都是可评分的。

sents.en: The module contains the literal multilingual patterns and summary-extraction rules.
sents.zh: 该模块包含字面上的多语言模式和摘要提取规则。
